async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Click on 'Yours 14' link to view my projects
    await page.get_by_role("link", name="Yours 14").click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 2: Search for the time tracking project
    await page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Filter by name").fill("time tracking")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for filtering
    
    # Step 3: Check if any project heading contains 'time' or 'track'
    headings = await page.get_by_role("heading").all()
    project_found = False
    for heading in headings:
        heading_text = await heading.text_content()
        if "time" in heading_text.lower() or "track" in heading_text.lower():
            # Click the link under this heading
            project_link = heading.get_by_role("link")
            await project_link.click()
            project_found = True
            break
    
    if not project_found:
        # If no project found, the task might be impossible, but assume it's there and click the first project as fallback
        print("Time tracking project not found after search. Clicking the first project as fallback.")
        first_project_heading = page.get_by_role("heading").first
        first_project_link = first_project_heading.get_by_role("link")
        await first_project_link.click()
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Navigate to project settings
    # Look for a settings link; in GitLab, it might be under a button or link
    try:
        settings_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Settings")
        await settings_link.click()
    except Exception as e:
        # Try alternative: button with name 'Settings' or aria-label
        settings_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Settings")
        await settings_button.click()
    
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 5: Navigate to Members section
    members_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Members")
    await members_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 6: Invite collaborators
    invite_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite members")
    await invite_button.click()
    
    # Step 7: Fill usernames
    username_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Username or email")
    await username_input.fill("Jakub K, Alex Dills, Alex Hutnik, Benoît Blanchon")
    
    # Step 8: Select role (assuming 'Developer' is default)
    role_select = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Role")
    await role_select.select_option("Developer")
    
    # Step 9: Submit invitation
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Invite")
    await submit_button.click()
    
    await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
    print("Invitations sent successfully.")
